name: STIHL MS 193 C-E
blurb: 12″, 14″ and 16″ lightweight bars on 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 44, 50 and 55 drive links (63 PM3), from STIHL's 2017 selection chart.
intro: STIHL's 2017 saw-chain selection chart (specifications as of 1 October 2017) puts the MS 193 C-E and MS 193 T in one block with the MS 192 C-E, MS 192 T, MS 201 C-EM and MS 201 T C-M. That block lists lightweight bars: 12″ with 44 drive links (63 PM3 44, bar 3005 000 7405), 14″ with 50 (63 PM3 50, bar 3005 000 7409) and 16″ with 55 (63 PM3 55, bar 3005 000 7413), all 3/8″ PICCO at .050″. The STIHL 2025 catalog chart does not name the MS 193. It keeps the same three lightweight loops on the MS 194 / MS 201 block. The file size is from the 2025 file table, which lists 5/32″ (4.0 mm) for 3/8″ PICCO.
notice: The loop numbers are the 2017 chart. The 2025 catalog chart does not list the MS 193. Read the bar stamp.

bars.note: STIHL's 2017 selection chart lists chain 63 PM3 44 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7405. The block header names MS 192 C-E, MS 192 T, MS 193 C-E, MS 193 T, MS 201 C-EM and MS 201 T C-M. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 12″ bar. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO. The 2025 model chart does not name the MS 193.

STIHL's 2017 selection chart lists chain 63 PM3 50 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7409. The block header names MS 192 C-E, MS 192 T, MS 193 C-E, MS 193 T, MS 201 C-EM and MS 201 T C-M. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 14″ bar. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO. The 2025 model chart does not name the MS 193.

STIHL's 2017 selection chart lists chain 63 PM3 55 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7413. The block header names MS 192 C-E, MS 192 T, MS 193 C-E, MS 193 T, MS 201 C-EM and MS 201 T C-M. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 16″ bar. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO. The 2025 model chart does not name the MS 193.
